title: The Temple Auntie
setting: Tuesday 6:30am. Banashankari temple. Anika asked you to drop off a small offering on your way to work — her grandmother's annual remembrance. You're standing in line. The auntie behind you has already decided you're shy and is fixing that.

beats.en: Brother! Which town are you from? Your face is new.
beats.beat: tapping your shoulder before you've finished turning

choices.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಆಂಟಿ. Bangalore ಗೆ ಬಂದು ಎರಡು ತಿಂಗಳ. Engineering work.
choices.translit: namaskāra aunty. Bangalore-ge bandu eraḍu tiṅgaḷa. engineering work.
choices.en: Hello aunty. Two months in Bangalore. Engineering work.

beats.native: Engineering! ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು. ಮದುವೆ ಆಗಿದ್ಯಾ ತಮ್ಮಾ? Age ಎಷ್ಟು?
beats.translit: engineering! oḷḷeyadu. maduve āgidyā tammā? age eṣṭu?
beats.en: Engineering! Wonderful. Married yet, brother? What's your age?
beats.beat: she has not blinked since this conversation began

beats.prompt: You take half a step away. You say:

choices.native: ಆಂಟಿ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ — ಈಗ time ಇಲ್ಲ. Job ಗೆ late.
choices.translit: aunty, svalpa — īga time illa. job-ge late.
choices.en: Aunty, ah — no time right now. Late for work.
Aunty I really need to keep moving.

beats.native: ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತೇಳು! ಪರ್ಫೆಕ್ಟ್. ನನ್ನ ತಂಗಿ ಮಗಳು — ಪ್ರೀತಿ. Twenty-five, Bangalore ನಲ್ಲಿ accountant. Photo ತೋರಿಸ್ತೀನಿ ತಮ್ಮಾ — ಒಂದು second.
beats.translit: ippattēḷu! perfect. nanna taṅgi magaḷu — Preethi. twenty-five, Bangalore-nalli accountant. photo tōristīni tammā — ondu second.
beats.en: Twenty-seven! Perfect. My sister's daughter — Preethi. Twenty-five, accountant in Bangalore. Let me show you a photo, brother — one second.
beats.beat: her phone is in her hand before you can object

beats.prompt: You can feel the line shifting. You say:

choices.native: ಆಂಟಿ, ತುಂಬಾ ಧನ್ಯವಾದ — ಆದರೆ ನಾನು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಒಬ್ಬರ ಜೊತೆ ಇದ್ದೇನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ ಬೇಕು ಆಂಟಿ.
choices.translit: aunty, tumbā dhanyavāda — ādare nānu īgāgalē obbara joḍe iddēne. nimma āśīrvāda bēku aunty.
choices.en: Aunty, thank you so much — but I'm already seeing someone. Your blessings would mean a lot, aunty.
Sorry aunty. I'm not ready yet.

beats.native: Ayyo, already taken! ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ ತಮ್ಮಾ. ಒಂದು Preethi ಗೆ ತೋರಿಸ್ತೀನಿ — ಬೇರೆ ಒಬ್ಬರು ಸಿಗ್ತಾರೆ. ಹೋಗಿ, late ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ — God bless.
beats.translit: ayyo, already taken! avaḷige oḷḷe āśīrvāda tammā. ondu Preethi-ge tōristīni — bēre obbaru sigtāre. hōgi, late āgtide — God bless.
beats.en: Ayyo, already taken! Blessings to her, brother. I'll show Preethi — someone else will turn up. Go, you're late — God bless.
beats.beat: puts her phone away. pats your back. forgives you for being unavailable.
